native_success: terminal official success; Reach L2 < 0.0625 m

gate.viability: Direct 39D reference reaches at least one failed K16 target on the weak body. If none, use limited direct FT probe before concluding inconclusive.
gate.fallback: If S1 degradation insufficient, test S2 using 0.75 times the S1 peak force in all 39 muscles. Register and verify effective force before using S2.

diagnosis.selection: Four failures closest to distinct quartile centers of terminal error, plus one median successful control per source; ties by goal. Prefix lengths 30,40,50,60,70 steps across those ordered cases. If a class missing, report limitation.
diagnosis.match: reset and replay saved native prefix; same goal, qpos/act/ctrl atol 1e-4, qvel 1e-3; control must reproduce native outcome. Reject invalid branches.
diagnosis.method: Independent seeded Gaussian random shooting around feedback mean in K16 or native action in 39D, 200 lanes each incl unchanged control and zero-perturbation repeats. Two 5-step blocks. Record all outcomes. Select best verified trial per case by native success then terminal error, subject to better short-horizon score or native success.
diagnosis.promising: at least 0.001 m lower terminal AND short-horizon error relative to same-space control
diagnosis.bc: On fixed-bank failed cases only, train raw-action residual. Require at least 2 distinct qualifying cases. Hold out last eligible goal, MSE Adam 0.001 for 200 full-batch updates. No fallback imitation of unverified proposals.

training.optimizer: fresh task-native PPO optimizer and adaptive LR; freeze source actor normalization in all adapting arms. Freeze actor variance/weights for residual arms.
training.extension: None; finite engineering budget, no convergence claim.

structure: Independent functional smoke; bounded 2% single-column reshape with recruitment re-fit, expand with a verified full-action witness residual direction, exact-zero initialization, check gradient, reload and old-body smoke. No witness => candidate unavailable; test mechanics independently.
cost: B3 physical budget includes 10000 monitoring, 30000 prefix+profile, 200000 paired search incl prefix and continuation. Equal sites/validation cost separately; all screening incl 39D viability is shared. Attribution by actual steps. Shared historical teacher 100000 steps and 18M source PPO per seed reported separately.
